exposure: Maternal-newborn ABO blood group congruency (for first-born siblings)
Maternal-newborn ABO blood group congruency (for second-born siblings)
cohort: Mothers in Ontario, Canada, with two consecutive live births between 2008 and 2022, for whom maternal and newborn ABO blood group data were recorded.
finding: Second-born infants with ABO blood group incongruent with their mother had a lower risk of serious neonatal infection (aOR 0.72), but ABO incongruence from a prior birth did not significantly modify this relation for the second-born infant.
